opciones.explicacion: It's the noun that expresses what someone thinks.

bloques.frase: Cap. 21. Sunt de acord, deoarece lectura este interesantă.

opciones.texto: I agree, because the reading is interesting.
Still, I consider it useful to read.
opciones.explicacion: That's what «Totuși, eu consider lectura utilă» says.

opciones.texto: In my opinion, the reading is clear.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase expresses agreement and uses «interesantă».
It is the defined form of «dezavantaj».

opciones.texto: I'll probably be out on Friday.
If I had time, I'd go on Friday.
opciones.explicacion: This hypothesis is expressed with «dacă aș avea timp».

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 22. Complete the «If I had time, I'd go to the sea.» hypothesis.
bloques.frase: Dacă aș avea timp, ___ merge la mare.

opciones.explicacion: The conditional appears in both parts of this hypothesis.
It's part of the composite past.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 23. What does «nu se fumează» mean?

bloques.frase: Cap. 23. Documentele se trimit prin e-mail.

opciones.texto: The documents are sent by e-mail.

opciones.explicacion: That's what «Formularul se completează online» says.
The phrase mentions documents and shipments.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 23. Complete «The form is completed online».

opciones.explicacion: It's the impersonal way for a general action.
It's plural and it means «se envían».

bloques.frase: Cap. 24. În timp ce mergeam, ploua.

opciones.texto: As I was going, it rained.
opciones.explicacion: The two imperfect describe the background of the story.

opciones.texto: After I went, it started to rain.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase does not count finished actions.

opciones.texto: When I got here, it stopped raining.
opciones.explicacion: These facts do not appear in the phrase.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 24. Complete «The wind was blowing slowly».

opciones.explicacion: The imperfect describes the ongoing action.
It is a relative preceded by the «în» preposition.

bloques.frase: Cap. 25. Muzeul se află la nord de centru.

opciones.texto: The museum is north of the center.
The museum is south of the center.
The castle is west of the river.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase speaks of the museum and the center.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 25. Complete «The castle is west of the river».
bloques.frase: Castelul se află la ___ de râu.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 26. What does «din cauza traficului» mean?

bloques.frase: Cap. 26. Deși avem puține resurse, economisim apă.

opciones.texto: Although we have few resources, we save water.
Since we have few resources, we waste water.
We have a lot of resources and we use more energy.
opciones.explicacion: It's not the meaning of the phrase.

bloques.frase: Cap. 27. Textul spune că artistul locuiește aici.

opciones.texto: The text says the artist lives here.
The artist says the writer publishes a novel.
opciones.explicacion: They change the subject and the information.

opciones.texto: According to the text, the monument dates back to the Middle Ages.
opciones.explicacion: That information appears in another chapter.

opciones.texto: The source of an information: «by the text».
opciones.explicacion: It presents where the data comes from.

bloques.frase: Cap. 28. Stimată doamnă, vă scriu în legătură cu postul vacant.

opciones.texto: Dear lady, I write to you about the vacant post.
I attach my resume and I look forward to your answer.
opciones.explicacion: That is expressed in other words.

opciones.texto: Ma'am, the announcement requires Romanian knowledge.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase does not mention the requirements.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 28. Complete «I'm attached to my resume.».
Cap. 29. What does «ar trebui să» express?

opciones.explicacion: That's what the composite past is used for.

bloques.frase: Cap. 29. E bine să dormi suficient.

opciones.texto: It's good to sleep long enough.
opciones.explicacion: «E bine să» introduces a general advice.
That's what «Ar trebui să reduc stresul» says.
That idea is expressed with «Sunt disponibilă pentru un interviu».
It is the defined form of «obiectiv».
